messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service="inference-runtime" | severity=high | incident=PD-8672 | policy=oncall-sre - page sent to PRIMARY oncall (Alex)
PagerDuty: Incident PD-8672 created -> https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incident/PD-8672 (details: high error rate from inference-runtime in us-west-2)
Alex: acked PD-8672 :white_check_mark: - I'll take this. pulling logs now
Maria: seeing a spike in 5xx from the edge too, ~15% errors last 5m. tagging in case routing or CDN issue: @alex
Alex: looks app-side, stack traces show repeated kv-cache misses and OOM in inference worker logs. past deploy at 15:02 looks suspicious. grabbing container logs...
Alex: ```
2026-07-09T15:08:21Z inference-worker ERROR OOM while allocating 1.2GiB
2026-07-09T15:08:22Z inference-worker WARN failed to warm kv-cache for session 0x4f2a
```
Jordan: PD escalation policy will escalate to secondary after 5m if not acked. keep us posted.
PagerDuty: PD-8672 -> 5m since triggered, no ACK by secondary -> escalating to secondary (Jordan)
Jordan: acked PD-8672 :hand: - on the way. quick question, do we have canary routing still enabled?
Alex: canary was flipped in the 15:02 deploy. I think rollout enabled new kernel selection that increases memory for some models.
Casey: I'm seeing the same OOM across two hosts. Suggest rollback to last stable model runtime until we root cause.
Maria: customer impact estimate: 12-18% of realtime text-gen requests returning 500s, latency up for another ~30% of requests. several customers reported degraded experience via support.
Oncall Manager: escalating to manager-oncall per policy due to customer impact and correlated deploy. manager please join if available.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty escalation -> manager-oncall triggered for PD-8672 (policy=oncall-sre, reason=missed ack window)
Oncall Manager: acked PD-8672 and joined call. thanks all. agree with rollback first, then put guard rails on kernel selection.
Alex: rolling back to runtime image `inference-runtime:2026-07-09-14-58` across the pool. running:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/inference-runtime inference-runtime=registry.redwood/inference-runtime:2026-07-09-14-58
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/inference-runtime --timeout=5m
```
Casey: scaling up pods temporarily to drain backlog: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-runtime --replicas=8`
Maria: I'm updating support and the status page: "Partial degradation in inference generation in US-WEST-2. Engineers are mitigating. No data loss."
Alex: rollback completed, monitoring. error rate dropping from 16% -> 3% in last 4m. latency trending down.
Jordan: PD note: PD-8672 -> marked as acknowledged by Alex, Jordan, Oncall Manager. secondary escalation closed.
PagerDuty: PD-8672 status changed to "acknowledged" by Alex at 1769507045
Alex: running smoke tests against canary traffic now. if stable, we'll hold current image and schedule a deeper postmortem.
Casey: reallocated a couple nodes and cleared KV cache on the noisy hosts: `curl -X POST http://redis-cache/flush` (reaction :thumbsup:)
Maria: and sent a quick support update to affected customers. created ticket S-4521 to track any follow-ups.
Oncall Manager: handing off to next oncall (Jordan) at 1769507400 — Jordan, please pick this up for post-incident ops and ensure a P0 blameless postmortem is scheduled if needed.
Jordan: will do. logging incident timeline and artifacts. initial customer impact window 15:02-15:20 PDT, rollbacks + scale completed by 15:13. I'll start the postmortem draft and share in #postmortems.
Alex: final note: root cause suspected bad kernel selection in the 15:02 deploy that increased peak memory for certain model ops. guard: add canary mem limit and automatic rollback if OOM rate >5% during rollout.
Incident Bot: PD-8672 -> resolved (manual) by Oncall Manager at 1769507448. follow-up: create postmortem and action items.
Jordan: thanks everyone. I'll collect logs, attach PD timeline, and ping product + infra for a follow-up review.
